shortDescription: Configure global OSPFv3 protocol settings on SONiC.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the operation to be performed on the OSPFv3 process configured on the device. In case of merged, the input configuration will be merged with the existing OSPFv3 configuration on the device. In case of deleted, the specified existing OSPFv3 configuration will be removed from the device. In case of overridden, all the existing OSPFv3 configuration will be deleted and the specified input configuration will be installed.
